steps.en: Install the CLI globally and start the proxy
steps.zh: 全局安装并启动代理服务

steps.en: Trust its root CA and point your system proxy at it
steps.zh: 安装根证书并把系统代理指向它

steps.en: Captures HTTP/HTTPS/HTTP2/WebSocket/TCP traffic in a web UI
steps.zh: 在 web 界面里抓取 HTTP/HTTPS/WS/TCP 流量

steps.en: Add a rule line mapping a URL to a local file or mock
steps.zh: 加一行规则，把某个地址映射到本地文件

steps.en: Applies the rule on the very next request — no app change, no redeploy
steps.zh: 下一个请求就按规则改写，应用代码不用动

value.en: Inspect and rewrite real traffic in minutes, without touching app code or waiting on a backend deploy
value.zh: 几分钟内抓包并改写真实流量，不碰代码、不等发版
